The journal is NOT reliable ground truth (5 weekend-dated rows, 6 of 60 strategy-month cells irreproducible, 190 rows vs a Summary of 189), but its disagreement with the report is small and structured: three attribution differences reproduce every STRATEGY-COUNT difference (they do not explain the August RF cell, which stays irreproducible, and which source is wrong is not determinable from the arithmetic). The cell test is necessary, not sufficient: a cell that passes is merely not contradicted. No row was used to choose any rule or parameter.
